exact_claim: Lean, nonrepetitive instructions, relevant tools, explicit authority and representative evals can improve quality and efficiency; reported effect sizes are directional.
implementation_use: Use as the current prompt/context optimization baseline; remove one group at a time and rerun held-out tasks.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Supersedes generic “more detail is safer” and permanent deep-thinking/multiple-approach rules.
review_trigger: OpenAI model-guide or Codex behavior change

exact_claim: Human attention is scarce; repositories should expose maps, executable feedback loops, isolated workspaces and agent-legible product surfaces. The reported architecture is repository-specific, not universal law.
implementation_use: Retain progressive disclosure, executable boundaries and product legibility; evaluate local transfer.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Narrow any rule that treats the OpenAI internal repository topology, review loops, file limits or doc-gardening cadence as universal.
review_trigger: Material OpenAI follow-up or local A/B contradiction

source: Prompt-Induced Waste in Large Reasoning Models
exact_claim: Generic deep-thinking and mandatory multi-approach language can multiply reasoning cost without improving correctness; scope, acceptance and stopping constraints are safer defaults.
implementation_use: Delete generic deliberation cues and require a changed hypothesis after repeated attempts.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Obsoletes blanket “ultradeep,” “consider every failure,” or compare-many-approaches instructions as standing policy.
review_trigger: Replication, revision, or local A/B contradiction

exact_claim: Much public skill content is nonactionable; progressive disclosure can reduce descriptions and bodies while preserving or improving measured function.
implementation_use: Separate actionable core from examples, schemas, background and version history; test faithfulness.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Supersedes automatic retention of shared-reference catalogs, output schemas and release history in every skill body.
review_trigger: Paper revision or local skill A/B

exact_claim: Body-resident content can be decisive for routing under heavy overlap; metadata-only decisions may fail.
implementation_use: Do not delete discriminative procedure or vocabulary without body-aware held-out routing tests.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Obsoletes merge/retire decisions based only on names, descriptions, embeddings or lexical similarity.
review_trigger: Paper revision or local routing results

exact_claim: Skill identity, count and set-aware presentation independently affect outcomes; more injected skills can reduce performance.
implementation_use: Use adaptive zero-to-few specialist exposure and evaluate set composition.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Obsoletes always-loading full profiles or treating skill count as capability.
review_trigger: Paper publication/revision or local activation data

exact_claim: Repository context files can increase exploration and inference cost while reducing success when they add unnecessary requirements.
implementation_use: Keep only minimal nonstandard requirements in active context; compare against no-context baseline.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Obsoletes assuming more repository prose is inherently beneficial.

source: Do Context Files Help Coding Agents?
exact_claim: Context strategy had no measurable correctness effect in the studied tasks; many failures were implementation rather than knowledge failures.
implementation_use: Treat context reduction as a cost/attention hypothesis, not guaranteed correctness gain.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Obsoletes claims that prose reduction alone will improve every task.

exact_claim: Agents can satisfy an oracle while missing the requested reusable artifact; tests prove only their checked surface.
implementation_use: Grade the real user/dependent-system boundary plus prohibited substitutions.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Obsoletes pass/fail claims derived solely from visible or hidden test count.

exact_claim: Long textual policy remains probabilistic; models can perform checks yet ignore their result or claim compliance falsely.
implementation_use: Keep consequential authority in code, permissions, schemas and external graders.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Obsoletes treating policy volume, reviewer agreement or receipt presence as enforcement.

source: DORA 2025 State of AI-assisted Software Development
exact_claim: AI amplifies the strengths and dysfunctions of the surrounding delivery system; outcomes depend on the organizational system, not model access alone.
implementation_use: Measure user value, flow, stability and supervisory work; improve environment and feedback loops.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Obsoletes generated-output and activity metrics as primary product success.

exact_claim: User focus prevents AI-assisted feature-factory acceleration and is associated with stronger organizational and team performance.
implementation_use: Keep one observable user outcome ahead of governance expansion.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Obsoletes feature/file/gate count as outcome proxy.

exact_claim: Small, independently testable changes shorten feedback and reduce risk.
implementation_use: Use one mechanism or product blocker per experimental slice.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Obsoletes portfolio-wide rewrites before a thin vertical result.

exact_claim: AI creation gains can be offset by verification tax, expertise gaps, tool sprawl and production-flow instability.
implementation_use: Measure review burden, interventions, rework and integration cost separately from generation speed.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Obsoletes token/throughput-only success claims.

source: NIST AI 800-4 — Challenges to the Monitoring of Deployed AI Systems
exact_claim: The report organizes monitoring categories and open challenges; it does not prescribe a validated monitoring methodology.
implementation_use: Use its categories to design questions; do not convert each category into mandatory infrastructure.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Corrects Agentic R75 title and overly prescriptive operationalization.

source: NIST AI 800-3 — statistical considerations for AI evaluation
exact_claim: Evaluation claims require explicit populations, uncertainty, data quality and statistical limitations.
implementation_use: Predeclare endpoints, units, repetitions and claim boundaries; report uncertainty.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Supersedes informal confidence arithmetic and leaderboard-only conclusions.

exact_claim: Identity, authorization, interoperability and security are priority research/standardization areas; concrete normative requirements remain emerging.
implementation_use: Treat as roadmap evidence, not a source of mandatory law IDs.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Narrows Agentic R147 and UltraGoal source-to-law promotion.

source: NIST NCCoE identity and authorization concept paper
exact_claim: Agent access requires explicit identity and authorization analysis; the document solicits input and is not a final standard.
implementation_use: Retain explicit principal, target, permission and effect identity; do not claim conformance.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Narrows Agentic R150 and any UltraGoal “NIST requires” language.

exact_claim: Govern, Map, Measure and Manage provide a risk vocabulary; implementation must remain context-specific.
implementation_use: Use for risk framing and decision ownership, not one-size artifact requirements.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Any draft profile or future RMF revision is provisional until final.

exact_claim: Secure development practices should integrate preparation, protection, secure production and vulnerability response into the actual SDLC.
implementation_use: Use as stable security foundation with risk-proportionate implementation.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Remains controlling while SSDF 1.2 is draft.

source: NIST SP 800-218 Rev.1 SSDF 1.2 Initial Public Draft
exact_claim: The draft proposes updated practices but is not final.
implementation_use: Use only as provisional gap input; label draft-derived changes.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Agentic R96/R151 duplicate draft entries should be consolidated and cannot be treated as final law.

exact_claim: GenAI development adds model, data, evaluation, misuse and supply-chain risks to SSDF practices.
implementation_use: Apply only to relevant model/tool/data boundaries.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Supersedes generic AI security checklists detached from the product boundary.

exact_claim: Build and Source tracks provide provenance and integrity controls for artifacts and source revisions; they do not prove behavioral correctness.
implementation_use: Use exact source/build/package identities and claim only provenance/integrity.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Supersedes SLSA 1.0/1.1 as current version; correct Agentic R98 release metadata.

exact_claim: Modern MCP is stateless-first; Roots, Sampling, Logging, Dynamic Client Registration and legacy HTTP+SSE are deprecated for new implementations, with compatibility windows.
implementation_use: Update protocol advice and Rust examples; link to protocol-era matrix instead of restating it.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Supersedes Agentic R27/R66 guidance that omits modern-era/deprecation rules.

exact_claim: A2A is for interoperable independent agent systems across boundaries, not internal subagents or tool calls.
implementation_use: Adopt only for real interoperability need; keep internal worker orchestration on native contracts.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Supersedes pre-1.0 A2A details and generic “multi-agent means A2A” assumptions.

exact_claim: Use traces, metrics and logs with versioned semantics; experimental GenAI conventions and deprecated compatibility surfaces are not immutable domain contracts.
implementation_use: Keep product/domain evidence independent of OTel and adopt stable fields selectively.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Supersedes hardcoded older semconv attributes and deprecated span-event assumptions.

exact_claim: Workflow replay requires deterministic workflow logic; externally visible activities need idempotency/deduplication and failure testing. Temporal is one implementation option, not a universal substrate.
implementation_use: Preserve effect identity, reconciliation, replay tests and optional adapters only when durability is required.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Obsoletes treating Temporal-specific topology as generic agent law.

exact_claim: Graceful shutdown requires explicit cancellation, task ownership and draining; untracked spawned work is unsafe.
implementation_use: Retain bounded tasks, cancellation and shutdown tests in Rust examples/engine.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Supersedes vague “async safe” claims without owned task lifecycle.

exact_claim: Evaluation context, providers, hooks and tracking standardize flag evaluation; use only where progressive delivery/experimentation needs it.
implementation_use: Keep feature exposure/assignment distinct and privacy-bounded; do not make OpenFeature mandatory.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Obsoletes flags-as-authorization and universal flag infrastructure.

source: Amershi et al. Guidelines for Human-AI Interaction
exact_claim: Expose capabilities and limits, support correction/dismissal, scope uncertainty, explain relevant behavior, give controls and communicate changes.
implementation_use: Design approval, diagnosis and agent-control surfaces for informed user decisions.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Supersedes opaque approval prompts and trust-maximizing UX.

source: Microsoft Appropriate Reliance initiative and empirical studies
exact_claim: Explanations can increase both appropriate and inappropriate reliance; source evidence, contradictions and uncertainty matter.
implementation_use: Show inspectable evidence and alternatives rather than persuasive rationale alone.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Obsoletes explanation volume or reviewer confidence as proof.

exact_claim: Self-organizing teams can average away expertise and lose up to 37.6%; more agents are not inherently better.
implementation_use: Parallelize only independent work and preserve explicit expert/root authority.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Obsoletes committee-style universal reviewer teams and consensus as quality.

area: staged agent workflow and bounded evidence
exact_claim: Fresh stage contexts, parent-owned bounded retrieval, valid abstention, transition-only receipts and stage-specific gates reduce contamination and receipt churn.
implementation_use: Adopt the architecture principles, not necessarily the Rust registry implementation.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Supersedes per-run receipt expectations and monolithic creator/evaluator contexts.

source: Design Judgment v5 corrected collector/reviewer campaign
exact_claim: Rigid filenames/receipt paths misclassified 49/50 runs; evaluator-owned capture recovered all 50 artifacts. Equivalent inspectable output must count.
implementation_use: Evaluator owns capture, resolution, blindness and grading; producer outputs final artifact, not evaluator custody structure.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Obsoletes path/receipt conformance as artifact-quality failure.

exact_claim: LLM judging is sensitive to presentation and can overcorrect; deterministic or counterfactual evidence and balanced presentation are needed.
implementation_use: Use blind randomized review, position swaps, explicit ties, deterministic endpoints and reviewer disagreement.
supersedes_or_obsoletes: Obsoletes one-reviewer consensus or rationale as final authority.
